dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...We've been entrusted with looking after the lad named Chouji. Uncle Onitaka told us to take care of him before setting sail..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...We'll bring him here once that samurai on the broken boat has been dealt with."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...It's too cruel that he's been separated from his mother and has been forced to live alone..."
